nodes.name: Verifica 230 · Lobet den Herrn, alle Heiden

nodes.name: Verifica 921 · Preludio (Fantasia) in do minore

nodes.name: Verifica 922 · Preludio (Fantasia) in la minore
nodes.critical_note: Flaminio's commentary calls it spurious; Dutch Bach Society presents it under Bach and relates it to Weimar. Conflicting assessments cannot be flattened into certain false/authentic.

nodes.critical_note: Flaminio H1 is BWV561 but browser title claims BWV583: metadata mismatch. Specialist literature questions Bach and considers other authors; do not assign to W.F.Bach, Kittel, etc as certain.

nodes.name: Verifica 571 · Fantasia in sol maggiore
nodes.critical_note: Netherlands Bach Society reports difficulty in establishing attribution and stylistic relation with early Bach; Flaminio more категорic 'attribuzione errata'; no specific composer proven.

nodes.name: Verifica 576 · Fuga in sol maggiore
